query: WITH household_members AS (SELECT w.head_of_household_id, w.wealth_level, hl.region, hl.city, hl.latitude, hl.longitude, COUNT(d.id) AS household_size FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index AS w INNER JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala AS d ON w.head_of_household_id = d.head_of_household_id INNER JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location AS hl ON w.head_of_household_id = hl.id WHERE d.person_status = 'صالح' AND d.death_date IS NULL GROUP BY w.head_of_household_id, w.wealth_level, hl.region, hl.city, hl.latitude, hl.longitude) SELECT wealth_level, AVG(household_size) AS avg_household_size, COUNT(*) AS total_households, region FROM household_members GROUP BY wealth_level, region ORDER BY wealth_level, avg_household_size DESC LIMIT 1200
